messages:
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout start: api-service v2 -> traffic-split 0%->5% at 09:00 UTC (change-window: 09:00-11:00). id=deploy_2024_06_15_09:00
Alex: starting the canary now, operator on-call: Priya. watch 5xx, 401, and auth latency. will stream logs to #eng-releases-monitoring
Priya: seeing a spike in 401 from mobile clients within first 2 minutes. user-agent shows MobileSDK/1.3.2 and MobileSDK/1.4.0-beta. sample log: `2024-06-15T09:02:18Z auth: token invalid uid=... ua=MobileSDK/1.3.2 status=401`
Marta: if it's a client-side auth change then older SDKs might be failing. can we route legacy UA to v1 while we investigate?
Sam: quick option: gateway supports header- or UA-based routing via the splitter. I can push a shim to respect `X-Client-Minor` header or fallback on UA regex. propose temporary routing rule: if UA ~ /MobileSDK\/1\.3\./ -> route->v1.
Alex: agree. Priority: hold traffic for affected UA and pause the canary if rule isn't applied within 5m. Priya, can you confirm % of traffic from 1.3.2?
Priya: ~3.7% of total requests during window (all mobile). Most failing requests are authenticate calls. creating a quick dashboard: /dashboards/rollout/auth-401-by-ua for operators.
Jing: tagging infra — gateway config snippet I tested locally, this should be safe and hot-reloadable:
```
# gateway routing snippet
match:
  - header: "user-agent"
    regex: "MobileSDK/1\\.3\\."
route: "api-v1-backend"
reason: "temporary legacy client routing until SDK fix"
```
Sam: I'll ship the rule to the canary router in 2 minutes. no infra deploy needed.
Rachel: customer success — heads up: one enterprise customer reported auth errors after the update, they're on MobileSDK 1.3.2. they'll expect a fix ASAP.
Priya: after the rule, 401s dropped to baseline within 90s. confirmed by dashboard. current split is still 5% but mobile UA traffic routed to v1.
Alex: good catch. pausing automatic traffic increases. manually keeping canary at 5% but with the legacy UA routing in place. we need an action plan: 1) patch gateway rule as permanent short-term fix 2) update release notes & CS template 3) schedule rollback if customer impact > 1% user errors for 10m
Marta: I'll open ENG-4589 for the gateway rule and ENG-4590 for SDK compatibility follow-up with priority P1.
Sam: pushed rule and posted config hash: cfg_9f1b2. deploy-bot: note?
deploy-bot: canary pause request acknowledged (id=deploy_2024_06_15_09:00). auto-escalation timer set to 10m.
Alex: if we see new failures in other clients, we'll do a rollback. rollback command (manual): `/deploy rollback deploy_2024_06_15_09:00 --to=stable --reason="client-compat-401s"`
Priya: monitoring for 10m. creating a short RCA doc draft and will attach to ENG-4589.
Rachel: I'll update the customer-facing status and add a note to release notes: "Temporarily routing legacy MobileSDK/1.3.x to v1 due to authentication compatibility; please upgrade to 1.4+ for v2."
Alex: thanks everyone. follow-ups: ensure changelog entry, add a canary test for UA-based routing in preflight, and escalate SDK compatibility to product. closing thread after final confirmation from Priya.
Priya: 10m check: all green, no new auth spikes in sampling window. marking canary as paused but stable with rule in place.
deploy-bot: deploy_2024_06_15_09:00 status=PAUSED by operator Alex. audit=id=7890ab
Alex: moving this to postmortem and adding runbook snippet to the release playbook for future UA-based fallbacks. thanks.
